approaches.name: national georeferenced cadastral platform consolidating municipal and multi-agency data
approaches.description: A national GIS platform consolidates municipal and multi-agency cadastral data, integrating disaster risk maps to produce hazard exposure information for planning. Practices: national cadastral information system consolidating municipal cadaster data; georeferenced land information system for risk and land-use planning; national data platform consolidating urban cadaster data; Cadastral data integrated with disaster risk maps for hazard exposure; Centralized GIS cadastral database integrating multi-agency data; National Urban Cadaster platform for urban management information.
